data.name: Purchase Order
data.description: A numbered purchase order to one supplier: dates, ship-to address, lines with SKU and price, totals and terms.

terms.label: Terms
terms.default: Please confirm this order, its prices and the delivery appointment before you ship it. Put the PO number on every packing slip and invoice. Do not substitute a product, color or quantity without our approval.

props.empty_text: Choose the materials this purchase order is for.
